description: This file contains functions for managing and rendering gutter elements in the CodeMirror editor, including getting gutter configurations, rendering gutter elements, and updating gutters based on changes. It interacts with other modules for DOM manipulation, view tracking, line number alignment, and display updates.

methods.name: getGutters(gutters, lineNumbers)
methods.description: Retrieves and processes the gutter configuration, returning an array of gutter objects with className and style properties, also handling the presence of line numbers.

methods.name: renderGutters(display)
methods.description: Rebuilds the gutter DOM elements based on the provided display configuration, updating styles and widths, and adjusting visibility.

methods.name: updateGutters(cm)
methods.description: Updates the gutter display by rendering gutters, registering changes, and aligning horizontally.
